name: Valdilana (Italy)
description: Blue field with a red Greek cross throughout fimbriated white, each quarter with a white L-shaped angle, and a yellow flower at the centre of the cross.
history: Municipal flag of Valdilana, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: fimbriation of the cross and angular lines in the quarters
flower at the centre of the cross
